notes_for_editor: No build year is given for either the wood or the steel tower. The 1910s is a general statement about wood lookouts in the county list. The 1924 date comes only from an FFLA photo caption on a July 2022 Facebook post. Coordinates in the county list (47.7303, -91.5545) match the brief, and the agency is correct. A YouTube video titled Jackpine Mountain Fire Tower exists, which may describe a standing tower and conflicts with Tower Gone; its page text was not readable, so it was not cited. Check that before publishing. No fate or removal date was found; no source read describes the site today.
